Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 88. Category: form. Ancient Saiyan Power.

Power-Up
The Saiyan pulls power from their S-cells without
tapping into the super Saiyan transformation, though
their aura still shines with a golden hue.
Increase your Movement Speed by 5 ft.
You deal an additional +2 to all damage
At the end of your turn, you lose 1 Stamina
Gained at Level 5 but is gained earlier if the “S-cell
Awakening” feat is taken
